task_objective: Cut auditor false positives from generated artifacts, Decky build-stamped metadata, and clearly plugin-namespaced environment reads without weakening secret or source-integrity checks.

plugin.json publish.image changes from the main ref to the release tag
plugin.json flags removes only the debug flag
package.json version is changed to the release version

design_decisions: Static source-behaviour rules skip extensions already listed in _NON_SCRIPT_GENERATED_EXTENSIONS, while secret scanning and metadata parsing still run.
ArchiveStats records a per-extension skipped-file count and both JSON and Markdown reports expose it.

Metadata suppression parses both sides as JSON and accepts only the exact observed Decky transformations. Adding root or any other flag, changing any unrelated key, or malformed JSON still emits MODIFIED_SOURCE_FILE.

Environment findings downgrade only when a literal os.environ key shares a normalized non-generic stem with plugin.json name. AWS, GitHub, Steam, SSH, Cloudflare, and private-key names remain MANUAL_REVIEW.

The SDH-Ludusavi SYNCTHING variables intentionally remain MANUAL_REVIEW because SYNCTHING does not share a stem with the plugin name SDH-Ludusavi; broadening that association would violate the plan's narrow heuristic.

The scanner-precision fixture intentionally remains BLOCK because its required fake GitHub token exercises the existing blocking secret rule. The initial PASS_WITH_WARNINGS test expectation was corrected for this pre-existing classification, not to accommodate changed runtime behavior.
